members.question: Will NVIDIA commence Vera Rubin production shipments by December 31, 2026?

evidence.quote: We shipped our first Vera Rubin samples to customers earlier this week, and we remain on track to commence production shipments in the second half of the year.
We expect every cloud model builder to deploy Vera Rubin.
We do expect pretty much every single customer to be purchasing Vera Rubin.

evidence.quote: This cloud will use the NVIDIA ® DSX™ platform and deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin accelerated computing powered by SK hynix HBM4, with the first AI factory planned to come online in 2027.
